item.title: Modern Warrior Life, LLC: Modern Warrior Ready, Dietary Supplement, 60 CAPSULES Recall
item.product: Modern Warrior Ready, Dietary Supplement, 60 CAPSULES
item.summary: FDA analysis revealed the presence of unapproved ingredients including tianeptine, 1,4 DMAA, and aniracetam. Product details: Modern Warrior Ready, Dietary Supplement, 60 CAPSULES
item.affectedPeople: The recalled product was distributed to customers nationwide from April 2022 until December 8, 2025
